name: touchline-manager-online
description: Root task runner. No application code lives here; see apps/ and src/.

scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.e2e:install: npm --prefix tests/web-e2e ci && npm --prefix tests/web-e2e run install:browsers
scripts.migrate: dotnet dotnet-ef database update --project src/TouchlineManager.Infrastructure --startup-project src/TouchlineManager.Infrastructure
scripts.migration:add: dotnet dotnet-ef migrations add --project src/TouchlineManager.Infrastructure --startup-project src/TouchlineManager.Infrastructure
scripts.migration:script: dotnet dotnet-ef migrations script --idempotent --project src/TouchlineManager.Infrastructure --startup-project src/TouchlineManager.Infrastructure
scripts.load:all: node tests/load/run.mjs login-burst && node tests/load/run.mjs dashboard-reads && node tests/load/run.mjs matchday-polling && node tests/load/run.mjs auction-contention && node tests/load/run.mjs matchday-publication
